newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Airways boss quits - company source.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Airways boss quits - company source.

text.p: Cyprus Airways chairman Vassilis Rologis has resigned to take up a new post as chairman of the Cypriot Chamber of Commerce and Industry, company sources said on Thursday.
Rologis was elected chairman of the Cypriot chamber last week and shortly afterwards tendered his resignation to the President of the Republic.

"He put his resignation at the president's disposal. The president asked that he remain at his post until another person is appointed chairman of the airline," a company source told Reuters, adding this was expected in the next few days.
Rologis was appointed chairman of the government-controlled national carrier in July 1993, replacing Kikis Lazarides, currently chairman of the Cyprus Popular Bank.
